data.name: Wander
data.detailed_description:
Wander is a cooperative exploration game where players enter dangerous, unfamiliar spaces to scavenge, survive, and make it back out together.

Up to four players explore a hostile dungeon filled with traps, roaming creatures, and environmental threats. The dungeon reacts to player movement and noise, and staying together is not always possible. Players can be separated, restrained, or placed in situations where helping a teammate puts everyone at risk.

Exploration is tense and methodical. Moving carelessly can attract attention or trigger hazards, while hesitation can leave players trapped. Communication is essential when visibility is limited and threats are nearby.

Each expedition unfolds differently. Players learn how the dungeon behaves, how enemies respond, and when it is time to retreat before the situation collapses.

Wander is about entering dangerous places, managing pressure as a group, and deciding how far you are willing to go before trying to escape.

data.short_description: Wander is a cooperative exploration game where traveling merchants roam strange environments, trade unusual items, and deal with unpredictable encounters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4,096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8,192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible sound device

content_descriptors.notes: Wander contains mild cartoon danger and fantasy slapstick scenarios. Some enemies or environmental hazards may harass the player in a comedic, non-graphic way. There is no sexual content, no graphic violence, and no depictions of self-harm, drugs, or abuse. All content is presented in a lighthearted, stylized, fantasy tone.
